facts: The red-brick 1952 town hall groups a municipal library, offices, shops and apartments around a raised courtyard. The council chamber is the dominant volume, and the two approaches include a granite stair and a grass stair.
The town hall is at Parviaisentie 9 in Säynätsalo.
The library and municipal building are joined by a raised courtyard. The exterior materials include red brick, sheet roofing and copper.
